status: Freeze before constructing any confirmation input or training outcome
prerequisite: third/memory/development_results.json complete=true and development_gate.passed=true under the pinned scientific freeze; otherwise no data construction or training
checkpoint_selection: Minimum new validation32 cross entropy at every50 updates; validation never reused as confirmation32
model_contract: Reuse pinned third/memory/models.py unchanged. full_mass and c1_mass use identical parameter shapes and initial values; pure memory uses a separately matched width. All use normalized Gram/cross statistics with inverse-mass-scaled ridge and FP64 matrix construction/solve; state and learned parameters remain FP32.
primary_rule: Report every variant/seed/length outcome. Candidate ability passes only when full_mass satisfies its task threshold for EVERY one of five seeds and EVERY length32/64/128, with all numerical checks valid. Never replace a failed seed with the group mean.
shape_comparison: Separately report paired full_mass minus c1_mass differences for 2 tasks x3 primary lengths, with unadjusted and Bonferroni-family95 Student-t intervals across6 comparisons. No new financial-specific or backbone claim follows from an ability pass.

challenges.clean512: Separate length512 evaluation, not a substitute for primary32/64/128 and not used in selection
challenges.async128: The clean128 latent task/inputs/labels with independent dt=clip(lognormal(-.25,.8),.05,4), FP32. This tests robustness to a changed time distribution, not a task requiring correct time integration.
challenges.gaussian128: Add independent N(0,.10^2) noise to every one of16 input channels of clean128, including markers; retain original latent labels and dt
challenges.missing128: Delete exactly floor(.25*filler_count) noninformative filler tokens per example. Evaluation generator alone uses memory markers4/5 or retrieval markers12/13; keep all informative tokens and final query. Accumulate deleted gaps into the next retained token to preserve total duration. Fixed filler counts ensure a common positive-dt batch shape. No marker logic enters a model.

challenge_rule: Report all failures and numerical checks without using challenge outcomes to change models, seeds, thresholds, training or checkpoints
freshness: No overlap of clean confirmation/validation inputs with historical matching-length synthetic cohorts, current new matching-length training, or other new validation/clean confirmation. Short finite-vocabulary training inputs may repeat. Perturbed conditions intentionally share clean128 latent tasks.
historical_scope: tools/hcsn v1/v2, next/sequence, next/ridge training/evaluation/challenges, ridge development, and completed third/memory development; not an assertion about every external project
seed_audit_scope: The data-free scanner checks declared integer seed fields in existing JSON only; post-gate exact-input audit is responsible for actual cohort overlap. No claim of auditing every possible derived random stream.

execution.working_set: current-max(0,inactive_file-file_dirty-file_writeback); admission requires conservative remaining capacity, and pending workers are also reserved

cost: Record per-run CPU/wall including initialization, compilation, training, prediction, diagnostics and persistence; training subcosts remain separate. Preparation and worker startup/failure costs are separate; shared-CPU timings do not establish energy or equal-quality superiority.
limits: Thirty fixed training runs; no HPO or retry with changed scientific settings
Synthetic four-class tasks with16 input dimensions, not language or multimodal pretraining
Model parameters approximately matched; state, FLOPs and fixed tables reported rather than matched
Five data/initialization seeds produce paired arms, not a broad population-level capability guarantee
Learned neural projections do not make fixed financial parameters end-to-end trainable
No confirmation execution if the development screen fails
